name: Fairvest Limited
summary: Fairvest Limited (Fairvest) is a diversified South African Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) focused on creating long-term shareholder value. Fairvest holds a portfolio of 130 retail, office and industrial properties valued at R13.4 billion (held directly and through subsidiaries). The average value per property held as of 30 September 2025 was R103.3 million. As of 30 September 2025, Fairvest held a 23.6% interest (2024: 5.0%) in Dipula Properties Limited (Dipula). As of 30 September 2025, Fairvest held a 79.9% interest (2024: 0%) in Onepath Investments (RF) Proprietary Limited (Onepath).
